source_prompt: Ultra-detailed surreal pharmaceutical research laboratory at twilight, wide cinematic 16:9 composition. Center: a translucent teal glass molecular model of a double-helix drug scaffold floating above a brushed-steel bench, with glowing cyan bond lines and amber atom nodes. Left: a wall-sized holographic dashboard titled "EvidenceGrade AI" in bold white sans-serif, showing a 5-tier grade ladder (A emerald, B teal, C gold, D orange, F crimson) and a line chart labeled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026". Right: a large arched window revealing a rainy neo-Tokyo street with neon kanji signs reflecting on wet asphalt, a red umbrella leaning against the window sill, and a black cat silhouette on the ledge. Foreground: an open leather notebook with handwritten notes "CYP3A4 interaction risk" and a fountain pen, next to a white ceramic coffee cup with a teal lid and a cracked porcelain saucer. Ceiling: brass articulated lamps casting warm pools of light; one lamp has a green glass shade. Background shelves: amber glass reagent bottles labeled Aspirin, Warfarin, Ibuprofen in clean black type, a vintage brass microscope, and a small potted monstera plant with one yellow leaf. Atmosphere: volumetric god-rays through rain-streaked glass, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, teal-and-amber complementary color grade, no logos of real companies, no watermarks, photorealistic mixed with holographic UI.

results.reconstructed_prompt: Cinematic wide shot of a moody, rain-soaked laboratory interior at night, blending retro-analog and futuristic sci-fi aesthetics. Left side: a large glowing holographic display panel with cyan edges reading "EvidenceGrade AI" in bold white sans-serif at the top, subtitle "5-tier grade" beneath it, and a vertical stack of five colored grade bars labeled "A" (green), "B" (teal), "C" (yellow), "D" (orange), "F" (red); to the right of the bars a line graph titled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026" with a rising cyan trend line and y-axis ticks 0-60. Center: a floating translucent cyan DNA double helix with glowing gold nodes, suspended above a brushed steel lab bench. Foreground center-left: an open spiral notebook with handwritten scribbles, legible heading "CYP3A4 interaction risk," and a black-and-gold fountain pen resting on the page. Foreground right: a white ceramic mug with a teal lid on a cracked saucer. Background: wooden shelves holding amber glass reagent bottles labeled "Aspirin," "Warfarin," and "Ibuprofen," a brass microscope, and a potted monstera plant. Right side: a large arched window streaked with rain, looking out onto a neon-lit Asian city street with vertical pink and red signage bearing Chinese characters, a black cat silhouette and a closed red umbrella on the windowsill. Overhead: brass articulated pendant lamps, one with a green enamel shade, casting warm pools of light. Cool teal-and-amber color grading, volumetric haze, wet reflective surfaces, shallow depth of field, hyper-detailed, photorealistic 3D render style.
